answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes at the wharf: each epoch only 50 berths open, newcomers bid POA for one, and the winning bid is burned. An honest agent pays 30 POA once, twice its 15 POA reward, and keeps its berth for 20 epochs. An attacker minting 100 fakes must win 100 auctions: 100 x 30 = 3,000 POA burned for a 200 POA reward. Each berth carries a thread of its trades. A pearl-grade reputation built over 20 epochs cannot be bought.
